description: Generate stable AGENTS.md workflows with native gpt-6-astra sub-Agent review; external Kimi and DeepSeek remain paused.

interface.shortDescription: Build stable workflows with native GPT-6 Astra review.
interface.longDescription: Generate and review scoped AGENTS.md rules with traceability, role-neutral module writer coordination, optional strict host attestation, independent acceptance, frontend browser verification, swimlane synchronization, and two read-only native gpt-6-astra review roles. External Kimi and DeepSeek remain paused.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $generate-agents-md to build or review this project's stable workflow. Main, parent, and child placement grants no inherent write authority; authorize exactly one registered maintenance/implementation Agent/run per module only through a matching unique active module write lease. The Dispatcher role is always read-only, and an implementation identity must not reuse the Dispatcher Agent ID or run ID. Close each affected module independently before read-only system aggregation. For a multi-Agent quality loop use $native-gpt-review-loop with two read-only gpt-6-astra children. Never call Kimi or DeepSeek while the external integration is paused.
